card.title: The Cleanup Person
card.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've peeled the surprise-party labels off the boxes by her desk. Same rescue service as last year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you. I told her they're printer supplies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll move the balloons before she asks which printer takes helium.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her I'll handle it. She already thinks I do all the office jobs; we can keep the cake under that.
